scripts.emulators: npm run emulators:stop && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-egso-prims
scripts.test:rules: npm run emulators:stop && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-egso-prims "vitest run tests/rules --hookTimeout=60000"
scripts.test:integration: npm run emulators:stop && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-egso-prims "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run emulators:stop && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-egso-prims "vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts"
scripts.test:migration: npm run emulators:stop && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-egso-prims "npm --prefix functions run test:migration"
scripts.test:functions:emulator: npm run emulators:stop && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-egso-prims "npm --prefix functions run test:emulator"
